description:
### Overall Layout
The figure represents "Panel 3: Softmax attention", organized in a balanced, top-to-bottom and left-to-right flow on a clean, solid white background:
- **Top Left**: A header block identifying the step number and stage name, accompanied by a subtitle tag.
- **Upper Center**: Two 14×14 heatmaps placed side-by-side—matrix $\mathbf{S}$ on the left and matrix $\mathbf{A}$ on the right—connected by a horizontal block arrow pointing from left to right.
- **Middle Section**: Two discrete vertical bar charts positioned directly beneath each respective matrix, precisely aligned with the matrix columns to represent the 14 values of row $i$.
- **Bottom Center**: Mathematical formulation defining the per-row softmax operation with row-specific temperature scaling.

---

### Component-by-Component Description

#### 1. Header (Top Left)
- **Step Badge**: A solid black circular badge containing a clean, white bold sans-serif numeral "**3**".
- **Panel Title**: Immediately to the right of the badge, crisp bold black text reads: **Softmax attention**.
- **Process Chip**: Directly below the title, a light warm-gray rounded pill tag containing dark charcoal sans-serif text: `softmax over the keys`. The pill features a distinct, vertical medium violet accent bar running down its entire left border edge.

---

#### 2. Matrix Heatmaps (Upper Section)

##### Left Matrix: Matrix $\mathbf{S}$ (Raw CLR Scores)
- **Title**: A single, clean black letter **S** centered directly above the matrix in medium-weight sans-serif type.
- **Grid Structure**: A 14×14 square grid of uniformly sized, borderless tiles with hairline white cell dividers.
- **Color Scale**: A monochromatic warm orange gradient ranging from very pale peach and cream (near-zero baseline values) to deep rust-orange and warm terracotta (high similarity scores).
  - Prominent high-value clusters form off-diagonal block structures (notably concentrated along rows 4–8 and columns 4–8, as well as rows 10–13 and columns 10–13).
  - The main diagonal cells are filled with a uniform, neutral light gray to clearly denote self-interactions.
- **Interactive Highlight Bands (Row $i$ and Column $j$)**:
  - **Row $i$ (Query Gene)**: A flat, translucent soft sky-blue horizontal highlight band spans across the 4th row. A crisp, bold blue italic label **$i$** sits cleanly outside the grid, centered to the left of this band.
  - **Column $j$ (Key Gene)**: A flat, translucent dusty-rose vertical highlight band spans down the 4th column. A crisp, bold magenta italic label **$j$** sits directly above this column.
  - **Intersection Cell $(i, j)$**: The cell where the blue row band and dusty-rose column band cross is highlighted by a sharp, high-contrast dark charcoal square outline.

##### Central Flow Arrow
- Positioned in the horizontal gap between matrix $\mathbf{S}$ and matrix $\mathbf{A}$.
- A solid horizontal block arrow filled with medium periwinkle-violet pointing directly from left to right.
- Directly centered above the arrow is crisp, medium-weight violet sans-serif text: **softmax**.

##### Right Matrix: Matrix $\mathbf{A}$ (Attention Weights)
- **Title**: A single, clean black letter **A** centered directly above the matrix in medium-weight sans-serif type.
- **Grid Structure**: An identical 14×14 square grid matching the exact dimensions and spacing of matrix $\mathbf{S}$.
- **Color Scale**: A monochromatic violet-indigo palette ranging from ultra-pale lavender and translucent off-white (near-zero attention) to intense, saturated dark royal violet (dominant attention probability).
  - Main diagonal cells are filled with the same flat, neutral light gray indicating self-interactions.
  - Due to softmax concentration, the matrix appears noticeably sparser than $\mathbf{S}$, displaying only a few prominent dark violet cells per row, reflecting sharpened attention distributions.
- **Interactive Highlight Bands (Row $i$ and Column $j$)**:
  - **Row $i$**: The identical translucent soft sky-blue horizontal band spans across the 4th row, marked with a bold blue italic **$i$** on its left.
  - **Column $j$**: The identical translucent dusty-rose vertical band spans down the 4th column, marked with a bold magenta italic **$j$** on top.
  - **Intersection Cell $(i, j)$**: The intersecting cell is prominently framed with a sharp, solid dark charcoal square outline.

---

#### 3. Row-wise Bar Charts (Middle Section)

Directly beneath each matrix sits a 1D column-aligned bar profile representing the profile of row $i$:

##### Left Bar Profile: Row $i$ of Matrix $\mathbf{S}$
- **Base Axis**: A thin, clean medium-gray horizontal baseline spanning the exact column width of matrix $\mathbf{S}$.
- **Column Guide**: The vertical dusty-rose column band from column $j$ extends downward seamlessly, encompassing the 4th bar position.
- **Bars**: 
  - 14 discrete vertical bars precisely aligned with the horizontal centers of the 14 matrix columns.
  - Baseline entries are near-zero, with only the top entries elevated: 5 prominent orange bars (a moderate bar at column 3, the tallest bar at column 4, followed by diminishing bars at columns 5, 6, and 7, and a tiny faint stub at column 8).
  - The bar at position $j$ (column 4) is the tallest, filled with deep saturated terracotta orange. Immediately to its right is a crisp magenta label: **$S_{ij} = 2.8$**.
- **Labels Below Axis**:
  - First line (centered): Semi-bold black text reading: **row $i$ of $\mathbf{S}$**.
  - Second line (explanatory note): Muted dark gray sans-serif text reading: `dark: top 5 kept (real: 50)`.

##### Right Bar Profile: Row $i$ of Matrix $\mathbf{A}$
- **Base Axis**: A thin medium-gray horizontal baseline spanning the exact column width of matrix $\mathbf{A}$.
- **Column Guide**: The translucent dusty-rose column band extends cleanly downward through column $j$.
- **Bars**:
  - 14 discrete vertical bars reflecting the normalized probability distribution.
  - Saturated deep violet bars: column 4 dominates prominently as a tall, sharp bar, while positions 3, 5, 6, and 7 show reduced or minimal heights, and all remaining positions sit flat at baseline zero.
  - Directly beside the peak of bar $j$, a crisp magenta label reads: **$A_{ij} = 0.64$**.
- **Labels Below Axis**:
  - First line (centered): Semi-bold black text reading: **row $i$ of $\mathbf{A}$**.
  - Second line (explanatory note): Muted dark gray sans-serif text reading: `sums to 1`.

---

#### 4. Mathematical Formulation (Bottom Section)
Centered horizontally below the two bar charts:
- **Main Equation**: Displayed in standard mathematical notation:
  $$\mathbf{A}_i = \text{softmax}(\mathbf{S}_i / \tau_i)$$
- **Parameter Annotation**: Positioned directly underneath the equation in dark gray text:
  $$\tau_i\text{ set per gene so that } k_{\text{eff}} = 3\text{ (real: 10)}$$

---

### Styling and Aesthetics
- **Background**: Solid, flat pure white with no drop shadows or decorative gradients.
- **Color Palette**:
  - **Matrix $\mathbf{S}$**: Pale cream and soft peach to rich terracotta and burnt orange.
  - **Matrix $\mathbf{A}$**: Pale lavender to deep royal violet.
  - **Self-Interactions**: Muted neutral light gray diagonal tiles.
  - **Row $i$ Highlight**: Light translucent sky-blue wash with a soft blue text label.
  - **Column $j$ Highlight**: Light translucent dusty-rose wash with a magenta text label.
  - **Values/Callouts**: Saturated deep magenta for specific numeric callouts ($S_{ij}$ and $A_{ij}$).
- **Typography & Linework**: Clean, modern sans-serif typography for all section titles, process tags, and descriptive notes; standard serif italic mathematical type for variables ($i, j, S, A, \tau$). Hairline separators and precise vertical alignment between matrix columns and bar charts ensure a rigorous, publication-grade academic presentation.

critic_suggestions: Row i bar chart of Matrix S: Color all 5 top-ranked bars in deep/dark terracotta orange to correctly reflect the annotation 'dark: top 5 kept (real: 50)', rather than only coloring the single tallest bar at column j dark. The remaining non-top-5 bars (2 low bars) should remain light orange.

Row i bar chart of Matrix A: Explicitly render the four smaller non-zero violet bars alongside the dominant peak at column j (A_ij = 0.64) to properly depict the softmax distribution over the top 5 entries, rather than flattening them into invisible baseline dashes.

Matrix S sparsity & contrast: Increase the contrast and sparsity of Matrix S so that it is mostly near-white/pale cream across baseline regions, with strong orange/terracotta saturation concentrated in the prominent blocks (genes 4–9 and lower-right genes 10–13).

Matrix A sparsity: Ensure Matrix A strictly demonstrates the sparsifying effect of the per-gene temperature softmax, displaying only about 5 distinct tinted violet cells per row (corresponding to the top 5 candidates) while all other non-diagonal cells remain near-white.

- **Grid Structure**: A 14×14 square grid of uniformly sized tiles separated by hairline white grid lines.
- **Color Scale & Sparsity**: Monochromatic warm orange palette (near-white pale cream to deep terracotta orange). The matrix is predominantly sparse (near-white baseline across most tiles), with dense high-value clusters concentrated along genes 4–9 and the lower-right block (genes 10–13).
- **Diagonal**: Neutral light gray diagonal squares indicating self-interactions.
- **Highlight Bands & Crosshair**:

  - **Column $j$ (Key Gene)**: A flat, translucent dusty-rose vertical band covering column 4, with a bold magenta italic label **$j$** above it.
  - **Intersection $(i, j)$**: The crossing tile at $(i, j)$ is framed with a sharp, high-contrast dark charcoal square outline.

##### Central Flow Arrow
- Positioned horizontally between matrix $\mathbf{S}$ and matrix $\mathbf{A}$.
- A flat periwinkle-violet horizontal block arrow pointing from left to right.
- Centered directly above the arrow is crisp violet sans-serif text: **softmax**.

##### Right Matrix: Matrix $\mathbf{A}$ (Attention Weights)
- **Title**: A clean black sans-serif letter **A** centered directly above the matrix.
- **Grid Structure**: An identical 14×14 square grid matching matrix $\mathbf{S}$.

- **Highlight Bands & Crosshair**:
  - Translucent blue row band across row $i$ (labeled **$i$** in blue).
  - Translucent dusty-rose column band down column $j$ (labeled **$j$** in magenta).

---

#### 3. Row-wise Bar Charts (Middle Section)

Aligned directly beneath each matrix, sharing the exact horizontal column positions of the 14 genes:

##### Left Bar Strip: Row $i$ of Matrix $\mathbf{S}$
- **Base Axis**: A thin medium-gray horizontal line spanning the 14 columns.
- **Column Guide**: The dusty-rose translucent vertical band continues downward seamlessly through column $j$.
- **Bars & Coloring**: 
  - Contains 14 discrete bars aligned with columns 1 to 14.
  - Exactly 5 prominent bars centered around column $j$ (columns 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) are filled with saturated, dark terracotta orange (representing the top 5 candidates).
  - The bar at column $j$ is the tallest, accompanied by a magenta text callout immediately to its right: **$S_{ij} = 2.8$**.
  - Two additional flanking low bars (e.g., columns 1 and 2) are rendered in pale/light peach-orange to clearly distinguish them from the top 5.
  - Remaining positions sit near baseline zero.
- **Subtitles Below Axis**:
  - Line 1: Bold black text: **row $i$ of $\mathbf{S}$**.
  - Line 2: Dark gray explanatory note: `dark: top 5 kept (real: 50)`.

##### Right Bar Strip: Row $i$ of Matrix $\mathbf{A}$
- **Base Axis**: A thin medium-gray horizontal line spanning the 14 columns.
- **Column Guide**: The dusty-rose translucent vertical band continues downward through column $j$.
- **Bars & Coloring**:
  - Dominant tall bar at column $j$ filled with deep saturated royal violet, accompanied by a magenta text callout: **$A_{ij} = 0.64$**.
  - Four small but clearly visible low violet bars at columns 3, 5, 6, and 7, reflecting the remaining non-zero softmax probabilities among the top 5.
  - All remaining bars are exactly at zero baseline.
- **Subtitles Below Axis**:
  - Line 1: Bold black text: **row $i$ of $\mathbf{A}$**.
  - Line 2: Dark gray explanatory note: `sums to 1`.

- Solid pure white background with no drop shadows.
- Crisp hairline boundaries between heatmap cells.

user_feedback: Copy the content reference cell by cell. S (orange) and A (violet) are 14x14 with the same sparse pattern as the reference: mostly near-white, dark block along genes 4-9 and lower right genes 10-13, and A has only about 5 non-white cells in each row (sparse). The bar strips must be aligned to the matrix columns: in the reference row i of S has 5 dark bars centred on column j (tallest at column j, S_ij = 2.8) plus 2 light bars, and row i of A has one tall bar at column j (A_ij = 0.64) and four tiny bars. Do not invent a symmetric bell shape; copy the bar heights and positions from the reference bars exactly.
